item.description: CellScript 0.15 Release Notes Release date: 2026-05-26. Release tag: v0.15.0 GitHub release: https://github.com/a19q3/CellScript/releases/tag/v0.15.0. CellScript 0.15 is the scoped-invariant, Covenant ProofPlan, and verifier soundness hardening release. item.title: NDAO-0000 burn unused treasury funds (1 posts)
item.description: Hey @chenyukang and @xjd, thanks for keeping the treasury economic model caveat explicit in the ZK voting PoC. PoC path: Reviewing the PoC from the ZK voting PoC, I understand the current solution as a Community Fund DAO v1.0-style budget request path: a proposal names a receiver and amount, voters cast votes, a ZK proof proves the result, and the treasury lock releases CKB to the receiver. Underlying assumption: CKB has already accumulated in the treasury, and keeps accumulating indefinitely. A passed vote releases part of that pot to the approved recipient and keeps the rest in the treasury.
